table.guard: always; + practice(c) only if L is not the tutorial and c is placeable at L
always; + practice(c) only if c is placeable at L + 1
always; nothing is added to the final exam
1 <= L' <= L (passed, never the tutorial), c has no portable practice item at the next level, and L' teaches c
always, whatever the review scored; nothing is added

none.description: No competency has a portable item and no level teaches anything: only the plain moves are legal.

open.description: Every competency is placeable and every level teaches everything: every practice add-on is legal, and no review, because everything is portable.

gap.description: No competency has a portable item and every level teaches everything: every review of a passed level is legal.

mixed.description: Competencies cycle placeable / on-route / none in COMPETENCIES order; review level L' teaches COMPETENCIES[(L' - 1) mod 11] alone.

scenarios.name: the conventional route: every level passed first time, nothing added
a failed level retried with practice, then passed and advanced with practice
a review after a pass, and the return to the frontier whatever the review scored
a review before the final exam
the final exam failed, retried, then passed
illegal requests are refused and leave the state and the log untouched
nothing is added to the final exam, and nothing leaves CERTIFIED
